title: Working in Mall World- annoyed
content: So for context, I came across this sub yesterday. All my life I’ve been a lucid dreamer and could even astral project frequently until I went some places that were supposedly not allowed. So for the last 2-3 years nearly all of my dreams have been mundane and boring enough to where I don’t really become lucid and it’s been driving me nuts. I work 55 hours a week minimum in waking life. So when I came across these posts with the AI generated images from the few dreams I had that were NOT mundane it blew my mind. Last night I had a dream I was working, but it wasn’t my normal job. I was a freaking cashier doing customer service at a grocery store (not even close to my normal job) and then someone came up and said “hey you don’t work here. Don’t bother” and then it dawned on me I was dreaming and working a crappy job in freaking MALL WORLD and I got reallllly angry. As soon as I became lucid I dropped the apple I was holding and as soon as it hit the floor it rotted immediately. I changed into my spiritual form and flew up so high and transformed into a burning bright white light with major intensity with the intent to destroy the entire place because it felt like just a trap for lucid dreamers and I woke right up before I went all Phoenix on it. For those of you wanting to protest being there, why not just destroy it? Why are people meeting up instead of getting rid of it? You know as long as you’re lucid you can do anything right? Well I know this is just a theory sub but if anyone saw anything go off it was me. Mall world is the worst. It’s just a distraction.
